items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yusef Lateef went there, his name was Bill Evans at the time, went to that same high school.

ctx.x: Yeah, so it was cool. So I thank him, and I saw him later, you know, I used to see him. He’s passed on now, but I used to see him an always like Bags and Milt and Al would always thank him. My brother Billy went to that high school, he knew Billy. Yusef Lateef went there, his name was Bill Evans at the time, went to that same high school. Eddie Locke…I can’t think of his name right now, the other bop…
